content.help: On: shorter loading screens, and textures look soft for a moment afterwards. Off: textures are sharp when a loading screen ends, and loading screens take longer. Applies when you close this menu.
On: less stutter from large textures, and new objects can look soft for a moment. Off: they load at full size, as usual. Applies when you close this menu.
Where the cache is kept. A new location starts empty and fills in the background, and the old folder stays until you delete it. Applies after you restart the game.
The full path to use when Cache location is Custom folder, for example D:\SkyrimCache. Applies after you restart the game.
